use_case: Admissions applicant scoring: ranks online inquiries and applicants by predicted likelihood to enroll and sets the admissions call order
vendor_or_model: Admissions CRM vendor's lead and applicant scoring feature (predictive model; not generative)
data_categories: Inquiry and application data: program, inquiry source, home ZIP code, device type, age from date of birth, military status, email and web engagement; aid estimate inputs
human_in_the_loop: Today: admissions representatives work the queue in score order; 31% of the lowest-scored decile got no human contact within 7 days. Required: every inquiry gets a human contact within 2 business days regardless of score; scores never decide admission
applicable_laws: Title VI (42 U.S.C. 2000d); Title IX (20 U.S.C. 1681); Section 504 (29 U.S.C. 794); Age Discrimination Act (42 U.S.C. 6101 et seq.); FTC Act Section 5 and 34 CFR 668.71-668.73 (accurate statements to prospective students); FTC Safeguards Rule for applicant financial information; Colo. SB26-189 from 2027-01-01 for Colorado applicants (counsel reviewing scope); CPPA ADMT rules if the college is a CCPA business (counsel reviewing)
status: In production since 2025-09 (online inquiries); approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Student-success early alert: predicts which online students may withdraw or fail a course so advisors can offer help
vendor_or_model: In-house gradient-boosted model built by Institutional Research on the data warehouse (not generative)
data_categories: LMS activity; attendance; grades; credits; account holds; age; home ZIP code; ISIR-derived Pell eligibility, Student Aid Index band, and first-generation status (to be removed); outputs: score, band, top factors (education records; customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (routes supportive outreach); escalates to Education if used for admission, aid, standing, or placement
human_in_the_loop: Advisor reviews each flagged student and decides whether and how to reach out; overrides recorded; no automated action
applicable_laws: FERPA 34 CFR 99.31(a)(1) (school officials, legitimate educational interest); HEA sec. 483 limits on FAFSA data; FTC Safeguards Rule 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)(ii); Title VI (42 U.S.C. 2000d); Title IX (20 U.S.C. 1681); Section 504 (29 U.S.C. 794); Age Discrimination Act (42 U.S.C. 6101 et seq.)
status: In production for online students since 2026-01; approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Website and student portal assistant: answers admissions, financial aid, billing, and IT help questions; signed-in mode reads the student's SIS balance, holds, and aid status
vendor_or_model: Assistant vendor (large language model with retrieval over college web pages and, in signed-in mode, SIS data)
data_categories: Prospective and current students' questions; in signed-in mode, SIS account balance, holds, and aid status (education records; customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None (information); escalates to Education if it gives binding answers on admission or aid
human_in_the_loop: Public mode: links to source pages and hands off aid and admissions questions to staff. Signed-in mode suspended 2026-07-22 after it returned another student's balance in testing
applicable_laws: 34 CFR 668.71-668.73 (misrepresentation, including website communications); FTC Act Section 5; FERPA 34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(i)(B) and 99.31(c); FTC Safeguards Rule 314.4(f)(2); disclosure of AI interaction (college rule)
status: Public mode in production since 2026-03; signed-in mode suspended; conditional approval 2026-09-17

use_case: LMS AI tutor and writing assistant (pilot): explains concepts and gives feedback on drafts
vendor_or_model: AI tutor vendor (large language model; LMS integration)
data_categories: Student prompts, drafts, and course content (education records)
consequential_decision_category: None (learning support); escalates to Education if used for grading
human_in_the_loop: Faculty grade all work; the tool gives feedback only and never grades
applicable_laws: FERPA 34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(i)(B) and 99.33(a) (vendor use of education records); FTC Safeguards Rule (no customer information expected); academic integrity policy
status: Pilot in 40 general education sections since 2026-05; continues only if the contract is signed by 2026-12-31

use_case: Online proctoring AI flags: flags possible misconduct in recorded online exams (face not detected, gaze, other persons, noise)
vendor_or_model: Online proctoring vendor (computer vision and audio models)
data_categories: Webcam and microphone recordings, ID images, exam session data; accommodation settings (education records)
human_in_the_loop: Today: faculty review flags, but 3 of 30 sampled cases were forwarded to the academic integrity office without review. Required: faculty review of the recording before any referral; the integrity office decides with the student heard
applicable_laws: Section 504 (29 U.S.C. 794); Title VI (42 U.S.C. 2000d); FERPA 34 CFR Part 99 (recordings are education records); Colo. SB26-189 from 2027-01-01 (counsel reviewing scope); vendor contract (FERPA terms in place)
status: In use since 2023 (about 18,000 exams a year); approved with conditions 2026-09-17
